name: have gone, not have went
rule: After have, has, had, is, was or been, use the third form of the verb.
go → went → gone. After 'have' it is 'gone'.

wrong.text: By noon, all the tickets had went.

right.text: By noon, all the tickets had gone.

spot: See 'have', 'had' or 'was' just before the verb? Check it is the third form.
deeper: Learn the three forms together: give, gave, given · write, wrote, written · take, took, taken.
'Was' or 'is' before it means something was done to the thing: the window was broken.
For most verbs the second and third forms are the same: walked, walked.
